summary: Russian forces advanced near Privile in Kharkiv Oblast, while Ukrainian troops liberated multiple settlements in Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia oblasts. Russian strikes on infrastructure in Kiev and Odessa regions caused power outages. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23733, @DeepStateUA/23734)
key_points: Russian forces advanced near Privile in Kharkiv Oblast, with Ukrainian troops repelling attacks in Novopavlivka and Novogeorgyivka. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23733)
Ukrainian forces liberated 14 settlements in Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia oblasts, including Zelene Hay and Vovchansk. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23734)
Russian strikes on fuel depots in Kiev and Odessa regions destroyed military equipment and infrastructure. (Source: @TwoMajors/390126)
Russian forces bombed Druzhkovka with FABs, destroying shelters and drone operator stations. (Source: @TwoMajors/390126)
Ukrainian forces restored a bridge in Krasnolimansk direction while Russian forces bombed it. (Source: @TwoMajors/390126)
Russian attacks on Kherson caused electricity and water supply issues. (Source: @TwoMajors/390126)
Russian forces struck a fuel depot in Kiev region with precision-guided weapons. (Source: @TwoMajors/390126)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are intensifying attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure and logistics hubs, while Ukrainian troops are conducting precision strikes to disrupt Russian supply lines. The conflict remains volatile with significant casualties on both sides. (Source: @TwoMajors/390126, @DeepStateUA/23733)
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian authorities are prioritizing infrastructure protection and troop rotations, while Russian forces focus on capturing key settlements. International sanctions on Russian oil and gas exports are exacerbating economic pressures on Moscow. (Source: @TwoMajors/390126, @DeepStateUA/23734)
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian military movements suggest a focus on capturing Kharkiv and Donetsk oblasts, while Ukrainian forces are prioritizing defensive operations and counterattacks. The use of FABs and precision strikes indicates a shift toward more destructive tactics. (Source: @TwoMajors/390126, @DeepStateUA/23734)
